sousTitre: Lesson 2: A Sunday with my family (Sessions 1 to 3)

notions.texte: To stop sleeping. — se réveiller
To wash your body with water. — prendre une douche
To clean your teeth with a toothbrush. — se brosser les dents
To eat in the morning. — prendre le petit-déjeuner
To clean the yard with a broom. — balayer la cour
To clean the plates and the pots. — faire la vaisselle

notions.titre: To go to church / to the mosque
notions.texte: To go and pray with other people. — aller à l'église / à la mosquée
To look at the programmes on television. — regarder la télé
To go and sleep at night. — aller au lit
I wake up at six every Sunday.
My mother cooks rice every Sunday.
chaque jour
chaque dimanche, le dimanche
l'après-midi
To go and see members of your family. — rendre visite à la famille
To go to the sea to swim and play. — aller à la plage
To eat at midday. — déjeuner
To have fun with games, like cards or awalé. — jouer à des jeux
To say stories to other people. — raconter des histoires
To make pictures with a phone or a camera. — prendre des photos
To have a good time. — s'amuser
dimanche dernier
la semaine dernière
il y a deux jours
We visited our grandparents last Sunday.
I played with my cousins yesterday.
My sister danced with her friends.
Aya studied her lessons last night.
went — aller
had — avoir

quiz.question: To stop sleeping:
quiz.explication: To wake up: to stop sleeping (se réveiller).

quiz.question: To clean the plates and the pots:
quiz.explication: To wash the dishes: faire la vaisselle.

quiz.question: « Balayer la cour » se dit…
quiz.explication: To sweep the yard: to clean the yard with a broom.

quiz.question: Complete: My mother ___ rice every Sunday.
quiz.explication: My mother = she: the verb takes an -s. She cooks.

quiz.question: Complete: My father ___ the car on Sundays.
quiz.explication: Wash ends with -sh: + es. He washes.

quiz.question: Choose the correct negative sentence.
quiz.explication: She + doesn't + verb, with no -s on the verb.

quiz.question: Choose the correct question.
quiz.explication: Do + you + verb: Do you go to church?

quiz.question: « Dimanche dernier » se dit…
quiz.explication: Last Sunday: le dimanche dernier. Next Sunday, c'est le prochain.

quiz.question: Complete: We ___ our grandparents last Sunday.
quiz.explication: Last Sunday is in the past: visit + ed = visited.

quiz.question: The simple past of « go » is…
The simple past of « eat » is…
Did you visit your aunt? — Yes, …
quiz.explication: Short answer with did: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

quiz.question: Which words tell us it is the past?
quiz.explication: Yesterday (hier) is in the past. Every day and on Sundays are for habits.
